attempts.summary: Bootstrapped a 3-member etcd v3.5.17 cluster across node1/node2/node3 (no etcd pre-existed), wrote application keys, then simulated permanent loss of the node3 member (stopped etcd, destroyed its data dir), and performed a proper etcd member replacement: removed the dead member via etcdctl on the surviving quorum, added a fresh member for node3, and started a new etcd instance there with --initial-cluster-state existing. Cluster returned to 3 healthy members with all original keys intact and replicated to the new node3 member. Then ran the mandatory node-restart evidence protocol: rebooted node1, node2, and node3 one at a time (preserving quorum throughout), confirmed each node's boot_id changed, and confirmed etcd health, cluster membership, and application keys fully recovered after each restart.
